0.description: [Pending Restart] - [Systemic] - [Flex Scaling] - Reduced the amount of health that the boss gains from bringing additional members by an approximate 7%. This means if a player added 1,000,000 HP, bringing that player will now only add 930,000 HP. This HP reduction in flex scaling is to allow for more flexibility in the raid composition and not increasing the amount of DPS required per player in "standard" raid compositions. Bringing an extra tank or healer will be less punishing towards your DPS check.
